ValidationRule.description: Validation to check Home Phone is entered in a correct format.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, NOT(CONTAINS( $User.Username,$Label.UnicaIntegrationUserName)), NOT(CONTAINS( $User.Username,$Label.AdobeIntegrationUserName)), NOT(CONTAINS( $User.Username,$Label.IknowToSfIntegrationUserName)), OR( AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCRM_Lead', NOT( AND( Text(Status) = 'Outcome', Text(Lead_Outcome__c) = 'Expired' ) ), NOT(ISCHANGED(Skip_Validations__c)), NOT( AND( ISCHANGED(Skip_Validations__c), OR( Skip_Validations__c = 'SkipValidation', Skip_Validations__c = 'Validate' ) ) ) ), AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = 'MLCRM_Lead',Text(Status) != 'Expired', OR(ISNEW(),ISCHANGED(Home_Phone__c))) ), NOT ISBLANK( Home_Phone__c ) , NOT(ISCHANGED(RecordTypeId)), NOT REGEX( Home_Phone__c , "^\\+61[0-9]{9}+$" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Home Phone entered is not in the correct format. Refer to help text.
